Record Class ItemCardLayout

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.export.ItemCardLayout
Record Components:
width - total card width in logical pixels
height - total card height in logical pixels
modelLeft - model viewport left offset in logical pixels
modelTop - model viewport top offset in logical pixels
modelWidth - model viewport width in logical pixels
modelHeight - model viewport height in logical pixels
imageSize - rendered image size dimension
labels - list of card text labels
public record ItemCardLayout(int width, int height, int modelLeft, int modelTop, int modelWidth, int modelHeight, int imageSize, List<ItemCardLayout.Label> labels) extends Record
Validated layout configurations for rendering item cards.

Native GUI coordinates; the capture target applies one integer pixel scale.

    • create

      public static ItemCardLayout create(ExportOptions options, int scale, MoleculeDef definition, String title, ToIntFunction<String> measure, int fontHeight)
      Creates and computes an ItemCardLayout for the given export options and molecule definition.
      Parameters:
      options - export configuration options
      scale - pixel scaling factor
      definition - molecule definition
      title - display title string
      measure - function measuring text width in pixels
      fontHeight - standard font height
      Returns:
      a new validated ItemCardLayout
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the card dimensions or space allocation are invalid

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
